svg.title: Planetary Model: shared infrastructure dependencies, 4 April 2030
svg.desc: Illustrative densities and boundaries. Familiar regional names orient the viewer, while proximity follows infrastructure. Restricted areas remain on PRIME’s continuous foundation.

path.data-tooltip: JANUS: a bounded UK-linked operating footprint for this stage of the story. Its extent is illustrative; reach is estimated, not a complete observation boundary.
